W2 (empirical), after E059. Tip E049: 5.198 s, 0.7535 (seeds 0-2). Rebuilds of the same commit gave 0.7535 / 0.7552 / 0.7536 (E049, E050, E057) at 5.198-5.223 s. The E036 tip gave 0.7497-0.7544 across four builds. So the 3-seed mean moves about 0.1-0.3 pp per rebuild, and time moves about 0.03 s.

Mechanisms, each tied to its experiments:
1. Epoch dial: about 1.5-2 s/pp, or about 5% of time per 0.5 epoch for 0-0.25 pp (E020, E023, E027, E049, E059). E059 (E046 vs E049) read 0.7543 at 5.19 s, so the 0.25-epoch step is inside the noise.
2. EMA (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon (+0.66 pp, confounded, E006) are already in the tip. More than 10 time-neutral boosters came out flat or negative (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044, wd and LS changes). Optimizer, averaging and regularization are flat within about 0.2 pp. I expect further time-neutral tweaks to land within ±0.15 pp of zero.
3. Time tracks pixels and steps. Early 20 px is nearly free (E026, E033). Trimming steps or samples costs about the dial's rate (E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever (E028, E034, E036, E046, E049). Freezing the stem before about 75% loses (E037, E054, E055). Group 2 tolerates a freeze from 85-90%.
5. Architecture cuts cost accuracy at the dial's rate or worse (E010, E021, E051).
6. Non-step overhead is about 2.5% (E047), so pure systems work saves at most about 1%.
7. Noise: the population mean is about 0.752-0.7535, so headroom over the 0.75 bar is about 0.2 pp. Seed sets used for keeps carry a winner's curse of 0.1-0.2 pp. Candidates cluster at 4.95-5.2 s and 0.752-0.756.

Misses: I over-predicted time when variants cut work, and I under-predicted accuracy on E053. Recent changes have almost all been neutral in accuracy at the 3-seed level.

Unsure:
- The rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean (I guess 0.08 pp).
- Whether the gate admits E046, E052 or E053.
- Whether coarse labels ship in the train pickle (torchvision CIFAR-100 does load them from the pickle, but the benchmark's TrainingData exposes only fine labels, so likely blocked).
- Whether the PCIe judge's build matches the local one.

forecasts.reason: Likely blocked because TrainingData carries only fine labels and a hard-coded mapping counts as external data. If it runs, the effect is probably small and within noise.
The port already freezes BN weights (requires_grad=False in the BatchNorm class), so this closes by code read with no run.
Saves at most 0.5% of time, which is below the build noise. Accuracy is likely neutral.
A diagnostic with no recipe change. The curves will probably order the outcomes roughly, but fuzzily.

cruxes: Does the benchmark's TrainingData expose CIFAR-100 coarse labels? If not, I091 is blocked.
What is the rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean? It decides whether any sub-0.15 pp keep is real.
Does the frozen keep gate pass E052, E053 or E046 on seeds 33-52? If so, ~5.0 s becomes the tip.
